capabilities: Drag text selections into a sidebar as Markdown cards
Create block-reference and heading-reference cards using native embeds
Drag cards back into the editor to insert content or embeds
Navigate to and highlight the referenced block, heading or source file
Clean up plugin-owned block-ID markers when deleting reference cards
extras: UI commands are currently in Simplified Chinese. Not yet submitted to the community plugin directory, so it must be installed manually from GitHub Releases. Requires Obsidian 1.8.0 API baseline; mobile and older versions unverified. Dragging needs an editable Markdown view, with commands as an alternative.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in side panel for parking text selections or reusable block/heading references as cards that can be dragged back into the editor.

relations.evidence: The repository's release structure was informed by cparsell/sidenotes

summary: Sidebar panel that stores block references, heading references and moved text selections as Markdown card files you can drag back into notes.
